Antares Mark-1: no DOE authorization after the 2026-10-23 NSDA approval found. Next gates (preliminary and final DSA) undated.

Last Energy PWR-5: no readiness review, DSA final approval or criticality found. KBTX (2026-09-11) said 'months'. Shipped record for this vendor is in news.json (2026-10-07 DSA approval), not in vendors.json.

Aalo-X: no criticality or construction news found after 2026-07-04. A fetched POWER article dated 2025-08-19 describes Aalo-X as a 10 MWe reactor and attributes the 30 MWth/10 MWe figure to Aalo-1, which conflicts with the shipped mwe_label that assigns it to the separate Aalo-X demonstration plant. The fetch returned a summary, not verbatim text, so no check was written. Needs a verbatim read of the Aalo-X primary source before any correction.

Valar Ward 250 / Project Beehive: BLM still at completeness review per NPR-based coverage; no November decision. Coverage conflicts on whether a separate Green River application was dropped; unverified, not written.
eVinci: no November 2026 news found. Latest is the 2026-08-25 Westinghouse zero-power criticality release and the 2026-09-03 DOE heated-core criticality release (both already shipped).

NANO KRONOS (not a shipped vendor record): NRC review schedule per secondary coverage shows draft EA/SE 2027, but the NRC project page lists milestones as TBD. Not a dated vendor milestone after 2026-10-30.
Natura MSR-1 (not in vendors table): no fuel salt receipt, criticality or NRC step after July 2026 found.
Deployable Energy Unity (not in vendors table): DOE documented safety analysis approval for the DOME test is reported in one search summary, undated and unfetched. Not written.

Steady Energy LDR-50 (not in vendors table): listing on Nasdaq First North (trading from 2026-10-02) and a 2034 first-unit estimate, both before the cutoff or unverified. No post-2026-10-30 milestone found.
Terra Innovatum and Blue Energy: no November 2026 announcement found. Terra Innovatum results were 2025 coverage. No results for Blue Energy at all.
